name: robodocks
description: A repository-agnostic, dry-run foundation for a reviewer-first automation tool.

scripts.lint: bun --bun run oxlint --type-aware --max-warnings 0 --report-unused-disable-directives src test bin scripts vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: bun check --no-script && bun run lint && bun fmt --no-script --check && bun run test
scripts.demo: bun src/cli.ts plan --policy examples/policy.json --input examples/review.json --database local/demo.sqlite
